summary: Validated the redesigned /profile/:reviewerSlug page + shared ReviewCard `showBusinessTag` prop. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass on /app/backend/tests/test_reviewer_profile.py (added coverage for new business_audience field per review, audience field in businesses_reviewed, and marcus-chen Verified Demo aggregation on ai-fiesta b2b). Frontend Playwright: /profile/ananya-iyer renders new dark gradient cover with 'Verified reviewer' pill, overlapping gradient avatar (initials AI), name 'Ananya Iyer', title 'Product Manager, Fintrail', bio, Instagram+LinkedIn links, Follow button, '342 followers', and full 5-stat strip (Reviews written 2 / Avg rating 4.0★ / Referrals 0 / Verified demos 0 / Member since Jun 13, 2026). 'Businesses reviewed' section shows 2 dark-violet-gradient logo chips (The Solved Skin, AI Fiesta); clicking ai-fiesta chip navigates to /business/ai-fiesta. 'All reviews' section renders 2 ReviewCard components (shared), each with business tag header (AF/AI Fiesta and TS/The Solved Skin) that links to /business/:slug; verification badges use same style as business page (Verified subscriber for ai-fiesta, Verified purchase for the-solved-skin). /profile/marcus-chen shows the Verified Demo badge on the ai-fiesta review with AI Fiesta business tag. Follow button toggles Follow<->Following, optimistic count 342->343, persists across reload (localStorage), unfollow restores to 342. REGRESSION passed: /business/ai-fiesta shows 12 review cards with 0 business tag headers and 7 working 5-star WhatsApp referral buttons (href starts with https://wa.me/); reviewer-link href = /profile/rhea-kapoor. /business/the-solved-skin: 14 cards, 0 business tag headers.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewCard `showBusinessTag` correctly defaults to false so business pages are unaffected — clean prop design.

Reviewer profile page's back link is hardcoded to /business/the-solved-skin (line 98 of ReviewerPage.jsx). This is misleading for reviewers who don't have a solved-skin review (e.g. marcus-chen only has ai-fiesta). Consider linking back to the referring business, homepage, or a generic 'Back'.

Follow persistence still uses localStorage keyed by reviewer_slug (not tied to a user account) and unfollow uses read-then-$set clamp (non-atomic) — same limitations flagged in iteration_3, unchanged this iteration.

Marcus-chen review card renders correctly with Verified Demo badge but that reviewer has only 1 review; the 'All reviews' section shows a single card in a grid — visually fine, but consider a single-column layout when reviews.length === 1.
seed_data_creation: None new. Follow test self-cleans (follow+unfollow returns to 342).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_reviewer_profile.py now covers 9 cases including business_audience/audience field checks and marcus-chen Verified Demo aggregation. Endpoint GET /api/reviewer/{slug} now returns per-review business_audience and per-business audience. ReviewCard has new showBusinessTag prop (default false) used only on ReviewerPage.jsx. Business pages verified regression-clean.
